sections.installation: Click the activate button and that's it.
sections.changelog:
v1.53.7

  • Fix: Components: Saving in the builder now sends only the components you changed, so a component deleted or edited in Settings or another tab while the builder was open is no longer brought back or reverted
  • Fix: Components: If saving a component fails (expired login, lost connection), the builder now shows an error and the next Save sends the component change again instead of silently dropping it
  • Fix: Editor preview: Image overlays (Overlay on, with a colour or gradient) now show in the block editor's live preview, so the preview matches the live page
  • Fix: Front end: The saved reading order no longer depends on what sits on top of what. An element is no longer read before its left neighbour, and Bring to front or Send to back no longer changes the order search engines and screen readers see
  • Fix: Builder: Releasing a dragged element no longer moves it off the alignment guide you saw while dragging (for example from an edge guide to a centre line)
  • Feat: Builder: If the tab crashes, the browser closes or the computer sleeps before you save, the builder now offers to restore your unsaved changes the next time you open the block (Restore / Discard)
  • Perf: Front end: Canvases are now sized with CSS instead of a script, so a block in a narrow theme column no longer jumps while the page loads, and contained blocks show right away instead of waiting for a script to fade them in
  • Perf: Builder: Editing, selecting and dragging stay smooth on large layouts: the timeline previews and canvas now redraw only the elements you change, and elements moved together in a multi-selection no longer redraw on every frame
  • Fix: Builder: Design Kit, typography, animation, component and other site-wide saves no longer fail silently. An editor tab left open overnight renews its security tokens and saves anyway; anything that still can't be saved shows a “Save failed” message saying what and why, and the block stays unsaved so nothing is lost
  • Fix: Builder: Saving right after another save or an autosave now always saves the page
  • Fix: Builder: Opening the builder in an editor tab left open overnight loads the current Design Kit, so saving no longer writes an old copy over newer changes; Convert to Canvas also keeps Design Kit variables added since the page was opened
  • Fix: Builder: Dragging a slider (Opacity, Border, Filters, Group layout), the colour picker or a gradient stop is one undo step, so a single drag no longer pushes your earlier edits out of the undo history
  • Fix: Builder: Typing a number in the box next to a slider is one undo step instead of one per keystroke
  • Fix: Block: Icons (button icons, icon buttons, arrows, video play and lightbox buttons) no longer disappear when an Author, Contributor or other user without the "unfiltered HTML" permission saves the page
  • Fix: Block: Images saved by those users keep their responsive sizes, and the block no longer reopens with "This block contains unexpected or invalid content"
  • Fix: Block: Blocks that already lost their icons this way open normally again, and the next save brings the icons back
  • Fix: Convert to Canvas: A Kadence Row Layout whose background colour was picked from Kadence's Style Library keeps that colour instead of turning white
  • Fix: Rendering: A canvas with a bad saved value (for example a width of "auto") no longer takes the whole page down with an HTTP 500 error on PHP 8; a canvas that still can't render is left out of the page and the rest of the page loads
  • Fix: AI abilities: Agent edits that set a size, position, rotation or opacity to something other than a number are rejected with a clear message
  • Feat: Privacy: The anonymous usage ping is also sent once after DropFlow updates to a new version, so the version counts stay current. Same anonymous data, never the site URL

v1.50.2

  • Chore: Code quality: Automated tests now check the layout maths (snapping, rotated bounds, grouping and loading older content) against thousands of random layouts; nothing changes in how DropFlow works
  • Fix: Packaging: A plugin package is no longer made when its scripts fail to build, so an update can't ship outdated scripts
  • Feat: Privacy: DropFlow sends one anonymous ping when it is activated or deactivated (a one-way site hash plus the DropFlow, WordPress and PHP versions, never the site URL), so we can count active installs. Details in the FAQ under Settings
  • Chore: Code quality: Plugin Check no longer warns about the PHP setting DropFlow briefly changes to keep decimal numbers exact in library packages
  • Perf: Rendering: Pages with DropFlow blocks render faster, especially with Static CSS on, and make one less database query
  • Fix: Rendering: A link to an element no longer breaks when another element's id is the start of its id
  • Fix: Builder: The Add Element menu now covers the selected element's toolbar instead of being hidden behind it
  • Chore: Libraries: The libraries DropFlow is built on are updated to their latest compatible versions; nothing changes in how the builder, editor or front end look and work, and the editor script is a little smaller
  • Fix: Text: The link editor no longer closes when you click into its URL field, so links can be typed in from the text toolbar again, and resizing the window while typing keeps the URL
  • Fix: Library: Blocks such as Avery Cover 4 no longer fail with "Integrity check failed for block.json" on hosts whose PHP prints decimal numbers with extra precision
  • Feat: Convert to Canvas: Flex Builder (Flothemes) blocks get a Convert to DropFlow button in their toolbar that turns the block into a canvas in place, keeping each element's position on desktop and phone, with text and colours taken from your site's Style Kit and Design Kit; anything that can't be converted is listed in a notice, and Back to blocks brings the original Flex block back
  • Fix: Builder: Exit in the canvas right-click menu now asks before leaving with unsaved changes, the same as the header back arrow, instead of saving silently
  • Fix: Groups: Cmd/Ctrl+G and Shift+Cmd/Ctrl+G no longer group or ungroup on the free plan; they show the Pro notice, the same as the right-click menu
  • Fix: Rendering: An element inside a stack or grid group that has no saved size for a device no longer logs PHP warnings on PHP 8
  • Fix: Convert to Canvas: A section with no background of its own now gets DropFlow's Background colour (which follows your site's palette) instead of a hard-coded white
  • Fix: Convert to Canvas: A Kadence Row Layout whose background is a theme palette colour (e.g. Palette 7) keeps that colour instead of turning white

v1.47.0

  • Feat: Convert to Canvas: The canvas now replaces the section you convert instead of being added below it; Back to blocks (or Undo) brings the original blocks back
  • Feat: Convert to Canvas: The toolbar button uses the DropFlow icon, and a slim progress bar across the top of the editor shows it's working
  • Fix: Convert to Canvas: Converted canvases span the full width (Contained off) and get a white background when the section has none
  • Fix: Convert to Canvas: Entrance animations and parallax are no longer converted, so every element is fully visible instead of starting at opacity 0

v1.46.0

  • Feat: Groups: Switching a group from Free to Stack or Grid keeps the order the elements are shown in (rows top to bottom, left to right), and the Layers panel follows that order
  • Fix: Frontend: A block's HTML now lists elements in reading order (top to bottom, left to right) so search engines, screen readers and AI read it the way it looks; stacking is unchanged

v1.45.0

  • Feat: AI: DropFlow now registers 22 abilities with the WordPress Abilities API (WordPress 6.9+, PHP 7.4+), so MCP plugins such as Novamira or the WordPress MCP Adapter list them and AI clients can read and edit DropFlow pages: change text, move, resize or restyle layers, add layers and sections, copy blocks, use the Library and check the phone layout, with a dry run before every change

v1.44.0

  • Feat: Convert to Canvas: The desktop layout, text sizes, colours and alignment are read from the live page at 1280px, so a converted section matches the page even where the editor shows it differently
  • Feat: Convert to Canvas: Core Cover blocks, overlays drawn by a covering element or ::before/::after, and gradients set over a photo now carry over; background photos keep their focal point, rounded corners and media library image
  • Feat: Convert to Canvas: Kadence feather icons use the matching built-in icon, and stacked or outlined icons keep their background, border and corner radius
  • Feat: Convert to Canvas: Sideways text becomes a rotated text layer, text on its own background keeps that background, and elements stack the way the page paints them
  • Fix: Convert to Canvas: Converting no longer changes the site's Style Kit text styles; text links to a style only when it already matches it on desktop and phone
  • Fix: Convert to Canvas: Rows sized to the screen height, sections the converter finds by their text, and repeated button labels are now measured correctly
  • Perf: Frontend: Each block's inline CSS is about 15% smaller, with no visual change
  • Fix: Editor: A stack or grid group placed inside another stack or grid group now shows in the right position in the block preview, matching the live page

v1.43.2

  • Fix: Frontend: Pages no longer go blank for returning visitors after a DropFlow update, because the browser now always fetches the matching animation, video and lightbox scripts

v1.43.1

  • Fix: Animations: Saving a block on a free or lapsed license no longer erases its stored animations, so they come back when Pro is renewed
  • Fix: Dynamic Data: ACF checkbox and select fields set to return "Both (Array)" show their labels instead of breaking the page on PHP 8
  • Fix: Components: A damaged component link in a block no longer breaks the page on PHP 8

v1.43.0

  • Feat: Convert to Canvas: Row and column background photos, gradient fills and overlays, and drawn icons (as Icon Buttons that keep their link and editable colour) now carry over
  • Feat: Convert to Canvas: StyleCloud entrance animations become On scroll into view animations, and parallax or fixed backgrounds become a gentle scroll-linked move (Pro)
  • Feat: Settings: A Docs link on the Plugins screen and in the settings header opens the full DropFlow docs
  • Fix: Convert to Canvas: Text and buttons now sit above converted panels and photos instead of being covered by them
  • Fix: Block editor: Elements at 0% opacity, such as the start of an entrance animation, show as a faint dashed ghost in the block preview instead of leaving it looking empty; the live site keeps the real opacity
  • Fix: Library: Imported blocks keep correct image URLs when an image was placed by URL instead of from the media library

v1.42.1

  • Fix: Image: Image and Dynamic Data images fill their box and keep the focal point even when the theme or another plugin sets image height to auto (for example on documentation or blog layouts)

v1.42.0

  • Feat: FAQ: Sections are now subtabs in the left-hand nav, with a search box across the whole FAQ and a new Free vs Pro comparison
  • Feat: FAQ: New visual previews for group layouts, image focal point and lightbox button, the animation timeline, easing, step navigation, button icons and Design Kit variables
  • Feat: FAQ: Documents the animation timeline controls, every Block Settings option, Copy from Previous and Clear Step Overrides, and lists each General setting separately
  • Feat: FAQ: New "Entrance animation (fade in up)" recipe, and the Initial entry explains that every animation starts there
  • Fix: Block: Full-width blocks now span the whole page on block themes with site padding (e.g. Twenty Twenty-Five) instead of leaving a gap on the right
  • Fix: Builder: Elements at 0% opacity, such as the start of an entrance animation, show as a faint dashed ghost while editing so they stay visible and selectable; Preview and the live site keep the real opacity
  • Fix: AI: Generated entrance animations (fade or fly in) now start hidden instead of showing, blinking out and fading back in
  • Fix: FAQ: Corrected which features are Pro (Backdrop Filter is free; the Design Kit is read-only on the free plan; right-click Group and Ungroup are Pro)
  • Fix: FAQ: Removed the Help (?) entry from the builder controls list; the builder has no guided walkthrough or Help button

v1.41.0

  • Feat: Design Kit: Ten built-in colour variables (Background, Background Alt, Dark Background, Heading, Text, Text Muted, Text on Dark, Primary, Accent, Border) are always available; edit their values to match your site
  • Feat: Style Kit: New built-in type styles Eyebrow, Button, Lead, Quote and Number, and every built-in style now has its own desktop and mobile size (existing sites keep their current H1–P sizes)
  • Feat: Library: Blocks from the Library use the built-in colours and type styles, so they take your site's styling; when a block brings a colour or type style your site already has, your version is always kept
  • Feat: Library: Fonts that only the block's linked text would use are no longer installed on import
  • Fix: Blocks: New blocks have no background colour by default, so the theme's page background shows through
  • Fix: Image: The image overlay now stays on top of a playing video
  • Fix: Import: Notes about kept site values show as neutral notes instead of red warnings
  • Fix: Import: Deleting an imported font in Appearance > Fonts also removes its font files
  • Fix: Design Kit: A new or imported variable can no longer replace a WordPress font's variable
  • Fix: Export: Font dependencies in exported packages keep the font style and no longer repeat

v1.40.16

  • Fix: Builder: Dragging an element on the canvas always moves it and gets its own undo step, even on a quick release
  • Feat: Groups: Stack and Grid group layouts are now Pro features; on the free plan the layout switcher and Layout panel are hidden, and existing Stack and Grid groups keep showing as saved
  • Fix: Convert to Canvas: Converted sections no longer get an extra empty text layer
  • Chore: Settings: The FAQ no longer lists the internal Export & Import (ZIP) developer tools
  • Chore: Tests: The Components settings test finds rows by their component class
  • Fix: Builder: Picking an image from the right-click menu replaces only that image, not the one open in the sidebar
  • Fix: Builder: Closing the builder right after saving no longer loses layout changes
  • Fix: Animations: If animations fail to load, saving the block keeps the existing animations instead of erasing them, and a warning is shown
  • Fix: Builder: The builder can be closed while it is still loading, and the page behind it no longer scrolls while it is open
  • Fix: Editor: Convert to Canvas asks before saving a page with unsaved changes
  • Fix: Frontend: Element anchors are cleaned to valid IDs, so an anchor with spaces or a leading digit no longer breaks the element's layout or the page's CSS, and existing anchors are fixed when the block opens
  • Fix: Frontend: Very tall canvases (16000px and more) keep their height and element positions on the live site
  • Fix: Frontend: Static CSS files load in the page head on classic themes and are rebuilt after a plugin update or a Style Kit or settings change
  • Fix: Frontend: The free plan's one-block limit counts per post, so archives, template parts and SEO plugins no longer hide the block
  • Fix: Frontend: The editor preview matches the live site for mobile corner radius, shadows, filters and hidden-on-mobile elements, and each block's CSS is printed once
  • Fix: Frontend: Older images with a colour overlay show it on the live site, duplicated blocks get unique element IDs, and shadows keep fractional sizes
  • Fix: Frontend: A block placed twice on a page animates in both places, and video embeds are cached
  • Fix: Security: The builder only accepts messages from the editor on the same site, so another site can no longer load it in a frame and run code
  • Fix: Security: Image lightbox captions are shown as plain text
  • Fix: Security: A block's stored animations can only be changed by someone who can edit a post containing that block
  • Fix: Frontend: Two posts sharing the same block ID (for example after copy-paste or duplicating a post) no longer overwrite each other's styles or animations
  • Feat: Settings: New "Respect reduced motion" option (on by default): visitors who ask their device for reduced motion see animated elements in their final state, without motion
  • Fix: Frontend: Click-to-play videos no longer start two players at once, and a second video with the same address plays
  • Fix: Frontend: Click-to-play videos that the browser refuses to start with sound now start muted instead of doing nothing
  • Fix: Animations: Scroll-scrubbed animations no longer jitter while scrolling
  • Fix: Builder: Right-clicking an element outside the current selection selects it, so Delete and Group act on what you see selected
  • Fix: Builder: Dragging a selection by a group moves every selected element, not only the group
  • Fix: Builder: Arrow keys typed in text fields no longer move the selected element, and an arrow press moves elements by exactly 1px
  • Fix: Builder: Shortcuts no longer edit hidden elements in Preview, and Escape inside a group steps out to the group
  • Fix: Builder: Ungrouping keeps the stacking order, and grouping or moving elements out of a Stack or Grid no longer makes them jump
  • Fix: Builder: Insert Element from the canvas menu respects the one-per-block limit and keeps new elements inside the canvas on both devices
  • Feat: Text: Links in text have an "Open in new tab" switch; new links open in the same tab by default, existing links keep opening in a new tab
  • Fix: Text: Cancelling a new link no longer leaves an empty https:// link, and scrolling while editing a link no longer wipes the typed address
  • Fix: Text: Text colour on bold, italic and other formatted words is kept when the text is edited again
  • Fix: Builder: Number fields with sliders no longer save empty or out-of-range values, and values broken by this earlier are repaired when the block opens
  • Fix: Builder: Typing a hex colour keeps its transparency, and font size and letter spacing fields no longer store partial text
  • Fix: Builder: REL stays editable when a link opens in a new tab, and Alt Text and Lightbox are available for images added by URL
  • Fix: Text: Addresses typed without https:// (like example.com) are linked correctly
  • Fix: Builder: Dragging an animation step's duration, resizing elements in a Stack or Grid, and pressing Undo mid-drag each create a single undo step
  • Fix: Builder: Paste Styles on text undoes in one step, and measured sizes no longer flicker back after Undo
  • Fix: Builder: A new Text element fits its content height instead of a 200px box
  • Fix: Builder: The element toolbar follows rotated, grouped and animated elements, timeline playback stops when the timeline closes, and an unfinished new Design Kit style asks before closing
  • Fix: Security: Library exports only include files from the uploads folder, and export zips are no longer left at predictable addresses
  • Fix: Security: Imported SVGs are sanitized, packages must declare every file they install, and the uploaded zip is deleted after a developer import
  • Fix: Security: Font family values in Style Kit presets and variables can no longer inject CSS into the site stylesheet
  • Fix: Security: Dynamic Data no longer shows protected custom fields, or the fields and featured image of a password-protected post before the password is entered
  • Fix: Library: Saved library blocks can only be replaced or deleted by their author or an editor
  • Fix: Admin: A failed update check is cached for an hour instead of slowing every admin page
  • Fix: Frontend: A malformed colour variable no longer causes a fatal error on PHP 8
  • Fix: General: Uninstall also removes DropFlow's export, library cache and library asset folders, and the plugin loads on PHP 7.2 again
  • Fix: Settings: Changing a colour and then quickly toggling another setting no longer reverts the toggle, and edits made while another setting is saving are no longer dropped
  • Fix: Settings: Deleting a component no longer erases components saved from the builder after the settings page was opened
  • Fix: Library: Adding a library block and closing the Library before it finishes no longer loses the block's colours and text styles
  • Fix: FAQ: Documents the Group element and its layout options, image focal point and alt text, and video options
  • Fix: Builder: Reset to Default on a group keeps the group and its layout instead of removing it; every element also keeps its Fill/Hug sizing and its component link
  • Fix: Builder: Images and shapes from AI generation, the library or older saves no longer turn on an overlay by themselves or lose their shadow settings, and already affected ones are repaired when opened
  • Fix: Builder: Elements in a Stack or Grid no longer spill past the padding or get cut off; a fixed width now shrinks to fit when padding or a narrower layout leaves less room
  • Fix: Builder: Text in a Stack or Grid grows taller when it wraps onto more lines, instead of being cut off at its old height
  • Fix: Builder: Switching a group between Stack, Grid and Free no longer shifts its elements by the padding or snaps them back to an old width
  • Fix: Builder: Elements in a Stack that hugs its content can be resized wider, and the Stack grows with them
  • Feat: Builder: Fill, image Overlay, block and icon background colors can now be gradients: switch the picker to Gradient for linear or radial gradients with draggable color stops, Color Styles in stops and your theme's gradient presets

v1.39.0

  • Feat: Builder: Elements inside a Stack or Grid now show the element toolbar, with arrows to move them one place earlier or later; the arrows follow the layout direction

v1.38.1

  • Fix: Builder: with Snap to Grid on, the drawn grid now lines up exactly with snapped elements at any screen width
  • Feat: Animations: Scroll-linked animations get an End option — Page (default, unchanged) or Block, which finishes the animation as soon as the element is fully in view
  • Feat: Typography: Custom typography now has a Font weight option
  • Fix: Layers: children of a Stack or Grid are listed in the same order they appear on the page, and dragging a row moves the element to that spot
  • Fix: Groups: switching a group between Free, Stack and Grid no longer reorders its elements
  • Fix: Groups: selecting an element inside a Stack or Grid shows its full outline and all resize handles instead of a line over the next element
  • Fix: Animations: the Scroll-linked Start toggle looks the same as the other tab toggles
  • Fix: Animations: the timeline Play button has a small icon instead of an oversized one
  • Fix: Colours: rgb() and rgba() colours now show on the front end
  • Fix: Colours: Kadence palette swatches in the builder match the colours on the front end
  • Fix: Plugins screen: the StyleCloud author link opens in a new tab

v1.37.0

  • Feat: Groups: Stack and Grid layouts are now available to everyone — select a group and switch it between Free, Stack and Grid in the toolbar

v1.36.10

  • Fix: Shape: a shape with no background is now transparent on the front end and in the editor preview instead of grey
  • Perf: Builder: editing, undo/redo and dragging or resizing inside stacks and the block height are faster, especially on large blocks
  • Perf: Builder: undo history keeps the last 100 steps, so memory no longer grows during long editing sessions
  • Fix: Builder: adding a component instance selects only the new element instead of keeping a previous multi-selection
  • Fix: Lock: the lock is saved with the block and kept through undo and redo
  • Fix: Lock: locked elements, and groups holding a locked element, can't be deleted until unlocked
  • Fix: Editor: blocks with a button or icon button missing its link or icon no longer break the block editor
  • Fix: Context menu: Copy Styles and Paste Styles are available for Icon Button
  • Fix: Canvas: arrow keys nudge the whole selection, and an element already off-canvas moves 1px instead of jumping to the edge
  • Fix: Canvas: dragging and resizing store whole pixels
  • Fix: Canvas: Snap to Grid lands elements and resized edges exactly on the grid
  • Fix: Animation: duplicated elements keep their own animation path instead of animating to the original's position
  • Fix: Animation: animations of deleted elements are no longer saved with the block, the library or exports
  • Fix: Animation: new steps never reuse an existing step name
  • Fix: Text: opening a text for editing no longer rewrites its content or marks the block as changed
  • Fix: Groups: ungrouping or switching a Stack/Grid group to Free keeps every element exactly where it is shown, including wrapped rows, aligned items and grid rows
  • Fix: Groups: parent groups resize with a nested group when its layout or content size changes
  • Fix: Groups: double-clicking a resize handle to stretch a group moves its content, and stretching an element inside a group updates the group
  • Fix: Groups: moving a group no longer shifts the content of a free group placed inside a stack
  • Fix: Library: inserting a library block or ZIP is a single undo step that also restores the previous animation timeline, even while a text is being edited
  • Fix: Builder: reopening a block with a Stack or Grid group no longer asks to discard changes when nothing changed
  • Fix: Animation: Undo and Redo keep you in the animation step you are editing
  • Fix: Inspector: editing a number field is a single undo step, invalid sizes are never applied while typing, and width/height go up to 10,000 px
  • Fix: Text: ⌘Z works while typing, a whole text edit is one undo step, and the header Undo is available during the first edit

v1.35.0

  • Feat: Groups: Stack and Grid auto-layout with hug/fill/fixed sizing, wrap, row/column gaps and per-side padding, rendered the same in the editor, Preview, library thumbnails and on the frontend
  • Feat: Groups: improved rotation and resize; switching to Free keeps children in place, switching to Stack/Grid fits the box to its content
  • Feat: Selection: Delete, Duplicate, Copy, toolbar and context menu act on the whole multi-selection in one undo step
  • Fix: Security: embed code in components and element defaults from users without unfiltered_html is filtered like post content
  • Fix: Security: Design Kit, typography presets, element defaults and components can only be saved by the Minimum Role for Settings
  • Fix: Security: the editor and builder only accept messages from the expected frame
  • Fix: Components: instances are read-only below the settings role, with an Edit button that explains why and points to Detach
  • Fix: Components: undo/redo of a component delete restores or removes the definition correctly
  • Fix: Components: reopening the builder loads the latest components and defaults and waits for pending saves
  • Fix: Groups: hidden groups hide their children on the frontend and in the editor
  • Fix: Groups: rotated and nested free groups render in the right place on the frontend
  • Fix: Groups: deleting or duplicating inside a group refits it, and empty groups are removed
  • Fix: Groups: arrow nudge and Align move a group's children and refit the parent group
  • Fix: Groups: ungrouping nested groups together no longer loses children; affected saved content reappears on load
  • Fix: Groups: Reset to Default keeps an element in its group
  • Fix: Layers: Move Up/Down, Bring to Front and Send to Back step past siblings, not children
  • Fix: Selection: Escape clears the whole multi-selection; duplicates keep stacking order
  • Fix: Renderer: an element rotated on one device only is no longer rotated on the other
  • Fix: Animations: timeline Play uses each step's duration and easing, with 600ms ease-in-out for steps without timing
  • Fix: Animations: smart-snap, arrow nudge and Align use the active step's position, size and rotation
  • Fix: Animations: timeline edits count as unsaved changes
  • Fix: Animations: Arrows, Dots and Step Counter keep working when a block has an HTML anchor
  • Fix: Import: imported Design Kit variables are kept on save and appear in the frontend stylesheet right away
  • Fix: Library: saving a block updates it instead of adding a duplicate
  • Fix: Defaults: Save as Default and components work for Icon Button and Step Counter
  • Fix: Video: signed/tokenised video URLs keep their query string
  • Fix: Dynamic Data: JetEngine media fields stored as a URL show as images
  • Fix: Static CSS: Regenerate All writes a file for every post on the free plan, with each block's custom fonts
  • Fix: Settings: switching tabs no longer reverts General settings
  • Fix: Uninstall: Delete Data on Uninstall also removes the saved local library
  • Chore: Saved blocks are migrated to the new group layout fields and keep rendering unchanged
  • Chore: Removed stale files from includes/

v1.34.0

  • Feat: Icon Button: new round, icon-only linked button with an accessible label
  • Feat: Icons: built-in icon picker plus custom SVG uploads (sanitized on upload) for Button left/right icons, Arrows, the video play icon and the lightbox button
  • Feat: Image: "Open lightbox with: Image or Button", with a 3×3 position grid and an optional "Show on hover" button
  • Feat: Insert menu: Heading (H2-linked Text) and Video (Image in video mode) shortcuts
  • Feat: Text: new Text elements link to the Design Kit P preset by default
  • Feat: Icons: icon size, button icon gap, play icon and lightbox button padding/radius are per-device (mobile follows desktop until changed)
  • Feat: Block: site-wide New Block Color (General → Elements, or "Set as default" in Block Settings) for newly added blocks
  • Feat: Convert to Canvas: icons convert too (simple shapes become Shape layers) and headings keep their H1–H6 tag
  • Feat: Convert to Canvas: "Back to blocks" toolbar button restores the original blocks, or rebuilds a canvas as a group of regular blocks
  • Chore: Edit sidebar: options regrouped into Content, Typography, Fill, Border, Effects and Advanced sections, with restyled inputs
  • Chore: Saved blocks: older blocks are migrated to the new per-device icon values and keep rendering unchanged

v1.33.0

  • Fix: Library: blocks saved by users without the unfiltered_html capability are filtered like post content
  • Chore: WordPress.org Plugin Check: escaping, sanitization and prefixing fixes, readme.txt and safer uninstall cleanup

v1.30.0

  • Feat: Block: new block controls in the block settings panel
  • Feat: Block: resize handles in Gutenberg, including a new top handle, with improved handle behaviour
  • Feat: Editor: double-click a block to open the builder
  • Feat: General: site-wide side gaps (Padding Guides) for desktop and mobile
  • Feat: Smart Guides: snap while resizing and improved guide matching
  • Feat: Design Kit: inherit fonts and colors from Kadence and Style Cloud
  • Feat: Fonts: Kadence fonts support and improved font dropdown selectors
  • Fix: Colors: fix overflow in the colors panel
  • Fix: Preview: more accurate styling in the live editor preview
  • Chore: Library: masonry view and refreshed modal styles
  • Chore: UI: restyled Design Kit, Block Settings and AI modal to match Figma; active header button states; helper text moved into tooltips; no underline on links
  • Chore: rename "Margins" to "Paddings" (Padding Guides)
  • Chore: PHP: document functions

v1.8.0

  • Feat: Animations: Pro keyframe timeline editor with per-step editing and per-element triggers (on load, scroll, scrub, click, hover) plus delay and loop
  • Feat: Animations: global Simple/Advanced switch — Simple mode reuses Style Cloud entrance presets as a separate integration
  • Feat: Canvas: element right-click menu (duplicate, delete, layer order, copy/paste styles, pick/replace image, lock, reset to default)
  • Feat: Canvas: global right-click menu (undo/redo, toggle grid, panels, insert element at cursor, save, exit, switch viewport, Design Kit, Library)
  • Feat: Image & Shape: CSS filters (blur, brightness, contrast, saturation, grayscale, sepia, hue, invert) and backdrop-filter
  • Feat: Design Kit: manage font, color and size variables with WordPress palette and Kadence integration, static CSS variable output, and unsaved-changes confirmation
  • Feat: Layers: rename layers and lock/unlock position
  • Feat: Image El: add focal point control
